item.title: Cameroon bishop denounces ‘normalized’ violence in Anglophone regions
item.description: Bishop George Nkuo of Kumbo in Cameroon’s war-torn North West region has denounced a decade of violence that has plagued Cameroon’s two English-speaking North West and South West regions.

item.title: Senior Italian cardinal’s remarks may be valuable advice for U.S. political hopefuls
item.description: 95-year-old Cardinal Camillo Ruini granted the wide-ranging interview which touches on politics in the Trump era.

item.title: US ambassador causes uproar by claiming Israel has a right to much of the Middle East
item.description: Arab and Muslim nations on Saturday sharply condemned comments by the U.S. ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, who said Israel has a right to much of the Middle East.

item.title: She was an orphan adopted from Iran by a US veteran and became Christian. The Trump administration wants to deport her
item.description: A woman adopted as a toddler by an American war veteran, who he found in the 1970s in an Iranian orphanage and raised as a Christian, is being threatened with deportation to Iran.

item.title: The bones of St. Francis are going on public display, a mixed blessing for Assisi
item.description: The bones of St. Francis of Assisi, the medieval friar who inspired Pope Francis and generations of Christians before him, are going on public display for the first time, giving his hilltop Umbrian hometown yet another reason to welcome pilgrims

item.title: Candid talk from senior cardinal on Pope Francis, Benedict XVI
item.description: In a wide-ranging interview with an Italian paper, Card. Camillo Ruini offered a forthright assessment of the Francis pontificate and flatly called Benedict XVI's decision to resign "a mistake."

item.title: Leo XIV prays for “embattled people of Ukraine” ahead of invasion anniversary
item.description: “I invite everyone to join in prayer for the embattled people of Ukraine,” Leo XIV said, “and for all those who suffer due to this war and every conflict in the world."

item.title: US says ambassador’s comments on Israel and the Middle East were taken out of context
item.description: An uproar continued Sunday after the U.S. ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, said Israel has a right to much of the Middle East, as more Arab and Muslim countries objected and the U.S. said his comments were taken out of context.

item.title: Display of St. Francis of Assisi’s bones confirms enduring appeal of relics for Christians
item.description: The bones of St. Francis of Assisi went on public display for the first time Sunday, capping an 800-year saga over his bodily remains and confirming the enduring appeal to Christians of venerating a saint’s relics.

item.title: Photos from Assisi as the bones of St. Francis go on display
item.description: Pilgrims will have yet another reason to visit the hilltop Umbrian town of Assisi, as the bones of St. Francis of Assisi, the medieval friar who inspired Pope Francis and generations of Christians before him, go on public display for the first time.
